description: Discover ultra-soft comfort and cozy warmth with the Fred Bear Camo Fleece Throw Blanket. Crafted from a warm and comfortable cotton / polyester blend, the camo sofa throw blanket offers softness and comfort for year-round use that is ideal for both inside and outside the house. From movie marathons to weekend adventures, this outdoor throw blanket is a must-have. Two Iconic Brands Unite: In collaboration with Bear Archery, the revered Fred Bear camouflage pattern comes to life through Rothco’s legendary apparel, gear, and accessories, including our Fleece Throw Blanket. Each item in the Fred Bear Camouflage collection has been crafted using the iconic Fred Bear camo pattern. Double-Sided Design: The bed throw blanket features the Fred Bear camo pattern print on one side and a tan fleece interior on the other side. The double-sided blanket offers a unique style that is perfect for bowhunting fans, camouflage lovers, outdoor adventurers, and more. The Perfect Size: Measuring 60 inch x 50 inch, these camo blanket throws are perfect for covering sofas, couches, and beds. These comfy throw blankets provide additional warmth for family and friends while binge watching tv in the living room and offer a cozy spot for your pet to take a nap. All Season Comfort: In addition to decorating your home, these soft blankets are great for traveling, camping, backpacking, picnicking, beach-going, and more. Keep one in your car as an extra backseat blanket for road trips.
